title: Project kind detection
responsibility: Read project kind and declared game dimension for scaffold eligibility and configuration.

inputs.name: detectProjectKind.root
inputs.description: Root directory to inspect for package.json and project marker files; an unreadable or invalid package.json is treated as missing, and failed file checks count as absent.

inputs.name: detectGameDimension.root
inputs.description: Root directory from which to read package.json for harness.dimension; unreadable or invalid manifests are treated as missing.

outputs.name: detectProjectKind
outputs.description: Returns the detected kind: a supported package.json harness.kind (app, lib, or game) wins; otherwise svelte.config.js, an @sveltejs/kit key in dependencies/devDependencies, or scripts.check containing svelte-kit yields app, a truthy parsed package.json value plus src/index.ts yields lib, and the fallback is unknown. Package read/parse errors and file access failures count as missing evidence.

outputs.name: detectGameDimension
outputs.description: Resolved game dimension from package.json harness.dimension; only exact 2d and 3d values are returned, and missing, unreadable, invalid, or unsupported values produce undefined.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: When detectProjectKind reaches the SvelteKit check after explicit-kind and svelte.config.js checks, a parsed package with no @sveltejs/kit key in dependencies or devDependencies and a non-null scripts.check value whose includes member is not callable makes it reject with TypeError; package read/parse failures and file access failures are caught.
